passwordRecoveryRevokesDurableSessions.proof: Calling revokeAllSessions on password reset invalidates all active sessions for that user across all devices; subsequent session validation throws SESSION_REVOKED (401).

githubOAuthLeastPrivilege.proof: GitHub OAuth scopes strictly limited to 'read:user user:email'; 'repo' scope is completely absent.

oneHundredBelieveVotesDoNotAlterTrustVer.proof: 100 BELIEVE votes recorded across 100 students on case-alpha-001 produced 0 mutations to trust verdict ('UNVERIFIED' -> 'UNVERIFIED'), 0 mutations to confidence (0.15 -> 0.15), and 0 mutations to status.

fiveStarStatusDoesNotGrantAuthority.proof: canSubmitAssessment explicitly rejects a user holding 5-star projection if they do not possess a verified qualification domain in private.expert_verifications (DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED).

sufficiencyThresholdPreservesTwentyUnits.proof: 5 quality events produced INSUFFICIENT_DATA and 1 star. 19 quality events produced INSUFFICIENT_DATA and 1 star. 20 events unlocked SUFFICIENT state and higher star projections.

expertQualityEventsIsSoleSourceOfTruth.proof: Stars are calculated dynamically from private.expert_quality_events; no direct projection write can synthesize or backfill qualification records.

moderationDecisionsDoNotAlterTrustVerdic.proof: Resolving a community report with REMOVE_FROM_PUBLIC_PROJECTION soft-moderates the community contribution while the underlying Trust Case verdict ('SUPPORTED', 0.92) remains 100% untouched.

moderationScopedToCommunityContentOnly.proof: Attempting to create a moderation case targeting a TRUST_CASE throws MODERATION_TARGET_DISALLOWED exception.
